name: showcase_sheet_impact_preview
_comment: doubled (~65k particles instead of ~400k). Note the sheet is 4 layers here
(18mm) instead of 3 -- at 6mm spacing, 15mm would round down to only 3 layers
and stop behaving like a thin sheet (see the preset's sheet_max_z note) --
so its native-space max Y differs slightly from the main-tier scenario, unlike
the 5 drops (unchanged). Axis conversion and drop coordinates are otherwise the

steps.label: viscosity_coe=0.003 -- same as SHOWCASE_SHEET_IMPACT on purpose: viscosityCoe is a kinematic viscosity (m^2/s) and must NOT be rescaled with the particle radius (internal design notes section 11.2)
preset doesn't override pressure_coe_scale -> addon default 1.96
no default single-box seed -- all seeding comes from AddFluidSourceBox/Sphere below
